snippet.title: True Nightmare: Diner Loop - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you. Can you escape?

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4072920/True_Nightmare__Diner_Loop/
